parts.name: Pressing Lid
parts.Basic_description: The pressing lid is the top part of the dispenser, made of durable plastic, small in size, and designed to be pressed by the user.
parts.Functional_description: It controls the release of the liquid or spray from the dispenser when pressed, allowing controlled output.
parts.Movement_description: It moves vertically downward when pressed and returns to its original position after release.

parts.name: Base Body
parts.Basic_description: The base body is the main cylindrical container of the dispenser, made of aluminum, providing structural support and storage for the contents.
parts.Functional_description: It holds the liquid or gas under pressure and connects to the pressing lid for dispensing.
parts.Movement_description: It remains stationary during operation, serving as the main housing of the dispenser.
